subject: BLOCKING review: do not turn -13 into a successful missing draw
body: Current render_encoder diff at drawPrimitives line2459 special-cases rc==-13: increments draws then returns without invalidating command. STATUS explicitly tests command remains valid/clear completes despite missing requested draw. This contradicts root/user contract: no silently altered semantics, no suppressed unsupported work; HANDOFF says implement, not support rejection, and existing Nord2 submission comment says Refusal is a command error, never a successful missing draw. Logging does not make omitting a requested draw a valid command. Remove the new -13 elision, preserve existing TEGU_INVALID/error propagation, and update tests to assert the refused operation yields command error (while preserving cleanup/no GPU submit for invalid input). This is not authorization to broaden/refuse more cases; implement when possible, exact errors otherwise. Root should not integrate the elision.
